text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical automation and AI-driven solutions, and I’d love to help connect your Pine Script setup to MetaTrader so your strategy can trade automatically with OctaFX on your RDP.

I understand the core of this job is not just “connecting two platforms,” but making sure the signal flow is reliable, the execution is automatic, and the setup is handled cleanly so you can use it without unnecessary friction. I can work on the integration logic between TradingView/Pine Script alerts and MetaTrader, and help structure the automation so trades are triggered properly through your broker environment.

My background includes extensive experience with Python, machine learning, and API-based systems, which is useful for building dependable automation workflows. In a recent project, I built a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. That assistant handled parcel tracking, rescheduling, and human handoff with full context, and it resolved 43% of conversations without an agent while maintaining a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. That project strengthened my experience with tool calling, orchestration, and building systems that need to respond accurately in real time.

For your setup, I can focus on making the connection between the Pine Script signals and MetaTrader execution as straightforward and stable as possible. I’m comfortable working with API-based automation and can help ensure the trading logic is passed correctly into the execution side. I also understand the importance of keeping the setup practical, especially when you already have an RDP and a broker in place.

If selected, I’ll work carefully to understand your current Pine Script logic, identify how signals should be transferred, and connect the workflow so the trades can run automatically.

One question: do you already have the Pine Script alerts configured to send trade signals, or do you need that part set up as well?
